# PV\*SOL online is a free tool for the calculation of PV systems

PV\*SOL online is a free tool for the calculation of PV systems. Made by the developers of the full featured market leading PV simulation software PV\*SOL, this online tool lets you input basic data like Location of your system, Load profile and annual energy consumption, PV module data (manufacturer, model, orientation, quantity etc.), Inverter manufacturer. Our automatic configuration manager will then search for the optimal connection of your PV modules and the inverter that suits best. After the simulation of the system, the results are presented: Annual PV energy, Performance ratio, Own power consumption, Solar fraction, and many more ...

Here you can enter your country and city, easy by clicking on a map - worldwide. You will see the latitude and longitude of your location

The Annual global irradiation and Average temperature is displayed as well.

PV*SOL premium
PV*SOL premium is the professional software for 3D design and simulation of photovoltaic systems – including precise shading analysis. For more than 25 years, engineers, planners, and installers worldwide have relied on this industry standard to optimally design PV systems, reliably calculate yields, and create bankable reports. Whether for residential homes or commercial rooftops, for full or surplus feed-in, or in combination with battery storage, electric vehicles, and heat pumps – PV*SOL premium models every system configuration realistically and flexibly.
The unique 3D visualization is the highlight of PV*SOL premium. You can visualize all common types of systems in 3D, whether roof-integrated or roof-mounted, whether on small angled roofs, large industrial halls or open spaces - with up to 7,500 mounted modules or up to 10,000 roof-parallel modules - and calculate the shading based on 3D objects. With the realistic shading from surrounding objects, you can achieve the highest reliability for your yield forecast.
All other design types from PV*SOL are of course also available in PV*SOL premium. Whether calculating self-consumption, designing battery storage or integrating electric vehicles - PV*SOL premium lets you implement any customer requirement in no time. You can also automatically generate fully customizable circuit diagrams, including safety components.
Our extensive product database includes over 30,000 PV modules, 9,000 inverters, 16,000 battery systems and many other products such as electric vehicles and performance optimizers. It is updated regularly by the product manufacturers themselves, so you can always work with the latest data.
Current feed-in tariffs are available in our database for economic efficiency calculations. Simply add your system costs to receive a detailed financial analysis of the system over 20 years. Finally, create compelling presentations and high-quality, fully customizable project reports for your customers at the click of a button - ready to send as a PDF. 
PV*SOL premium is available in German 🇩🇪, English 🇬🇧, Spanish 🇪🇸, French 🇫🇷, Italian 🇮🇹, Polish 🇵🇱, Czech 🇨🇿, Portuguese 🇵🇹 and Turkish 🇹🇷. And with project reports available in 24 languages, language barriers are a thing of the past.
Our technical support team and our help pages offer you assistance with your questions. In our forum you can address more complex questions to our team and other PV*SOL premium users.
Would you like to try out whether PV*SOL premium fits your design process? Download the free trial version now!
Download trial version
Product highlights
Detailed 3D shading analysis
A three-dimensional representation of surrounding objects is extremely important for determining the reduction in yield due to shading. With PV*SOL premium, you can visualize all roof-integrated and mounted systems - even in open spaces - with up to 7,500 mounted modules or up to 10,000 roof-parallel modules in 3D and calculate the shading based on 3D objects. 
Extrude buildings in 3D
Buildings and objects can be created quickly and easily using floor plans, cadastral maps and map screenshots. First the contours are traced, then the building can be extruded by entering the height (any type of building with a pitched or flat roof). In addition, high-resolution orthophotos and elevation data are available via the Google Solar API, and 3D building models for Germany are available via Rexplorer. This makes the PV design in 3D even faster and more accurate.
Global climate data available
PV*SOL premium provides you with high-quality TMY data sets for every km² in Germany (own procedure based on DWD data) and for any location worldwide with Meteonorm 9 (data period 2001-2020). In addition, PVGIS, Solcast and SolarAnywhere are available as providers. You can use the interactive map to conveniently select the climate data. Own measurement data can be imported via files in DWD, Meteonorm or WBV format.
More program details
Import of 3D models
3D models of different file formats can be imported to enter object data. This adds another important tool to the existing option of reading floor plans, cadastral maps and screenshots from web-based satellite maps (e.g. Google Earth) directly into the 3D visualization.
Module assignment in 3D view
The roof areas are covered with the maximum possible number of modules automatically, or manually by tracing the areas to be covered by PV. If required, PV*SOL premium can show you the annual radiation reduction (direct and diffuse radiation) for every point of the PV area and for each module. Thanks to interfaces to planning tools like K2 Base (K2 systems) and PV-Configurator (Renusol), systems no longer have to be planned twice.
Polymorphic interconnection in combination with optimizers
Flexibility has been significantly increased when interconnecting the modules that are automatically placed on an object. The new option of polystring interconnection means that completely different strings can be connected in parallel or in series to an MPP tracker. Even different modules in one string, e.g. defective modules that are no longer available, can be replaced with similar ones.
Optimization of the module interconnection
You decide whether you want to connect several module areas to one inverter or choose a separate inverter for each module area, or combine both. The current status of the system check is displayed in the configuration window at all times. The automatic interconnection has been fundamentally improved; in addition, interconnections can be suggested for SolarEdge products.
Current online databases
In our extensive product databases you can currently find data records of over 30,000 PV modules, 8,500 inverters, 12,500 battery systems and many other products such as electric vehicles and performance optimizers, which are updated by the manufacturers. With our online databases, you can easily make your own products available to others.
Detailed project report
Create comprehensive project reports with simulation results and technical details in 24 languages and export them as Word or PDF documents. You can add your company logo to the report and specify which content should be displayed. A visually appealing customer presentation for quotations and customer consultations is also available.
Grid-connected systems with battery storage
Design your own battery storage system by selecting the batteries and defining the battery inverter and charging strategy. Alternatively, you can load battery systems from leading manufacturers. Thermal systems can also be flexibly connected to both AC- and DC-coupled battery storage systems.
Electric vehicles 
Select one or more electric vehicles that are simulated in combination with the photovoltaic system. By entering the daily mileage and the downtimes, PV*SOL calculates how much PV energy can be used to charge the electric vehicles. 
Summary of results 
The detailed results overview contains representations of the simulation results, the results of cost-effectiveness and a detailed tabular energy balance with all the gains and losses that occur. Carpetplots immediately provide you with an annual overview of individual results. 
Circuit diagram
PV*SOL supports your system design with an automatically generated, freely configurable circuit diagram. Both the string cable losses and the AC and DC cable losses per inverter can be determined. Numerous safety devices such as fuses, switch disconnectors and surge protection can be easily added.
Thermal System
Use your solar energy to support the boiler in the thermal system as heating supply using a heating rod or a simplified model of a air-water heatpump. 
Other features 
Choose which models you want to use for diffuse radiation and radiation on the inclined surface. The U-I and U-P characteristics for each time step can be produced when required. Exchange your user ID to share self-created products within your company.

# PV\*SOL premium

PV\*SOL premium is the professional software for 3D design and simulation of photovoltaic systems – including precise shading analysis. For more than 25 years, engineers, planners, and installers worldwide have relied on this industry standard to optimally design PV systems, reliably calculate yields, and create bankable reports. Whether for residential homes or commercial rooftops, for full or surplus feed-in, or in combination with battery storage, electric vehicles, and heat pumps – PV\*SOL premium models every system configuration realistically and flexibly.

The unique 3D visualization is the highlight of PV\*SOL premium. You can visualize all common types of systems in 3D, whether roof-integrated or roof-mounted, whether on small angled roofs, large industrial halls or open spaces - with up to 7,500 mounted modules or up to 10,000 roof-parallel modules - and calculate the shading based on 3D objects. With the realistic shading from surrounding objects, you can achieve the highest reliability for your yield forecast.

All other design types from PV\*SOL are of course also available in PV\*SOL premium. Whether calculating self-consumption, designing battery storage or integrating electric vehicles - PV\*SOL premium lets you implement any customer requirement in no time. You can also automatically generate fully customizable circuit diagrams, including safety components.

Our [extensive product database](https://pvsol-database.valentin-software.com/) includes over 30,000 PV modules, 9,000 inverters, 16,000 battery systems and many other products such as electric vehicles and performance optimizers. It is updated regularly by the product manufacturers themselves, so you can always work with the latest data.

##### Detailed 3D shading analysis

A three-dimensional representation of surrounding objects is extremely important for determining the reduction in yield due to shading. With PV\*SOL premium, you can visualize all roof-integrated and mounted systems - even in open spaces - with up to 7,500 mounted modules or up to 10,000 roof-parallel modules in 3D and calculate the **shading based on 3D objects.**

![](/wp-content/uploads/pvsol-premium-map.jpg)

##### Extrude buildings in 3D

Buildings and objects can be created quickly and easily using floor plans, cadastral maps and map screenshots. First the contours are traced, then the **building can be extruded by entering the height** (any type of building with a pitched or flat roof). In addition, high-resolution orthophotos and elevation data are available via the [Google Solar API](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zQ-cooyD5lo), and 3D building models for Germany are available via [Rexplorer](https://pvsol.rexplorer.ee/). This makes the PV design in 3D even faster and more accurate.

![](https://valentin-software.com/wp-content/uploads/pvsolpremium-meteosyn-detail-02_EN.png)

##### Global climate data available

PV\*SOL premium provides you with high-quality TMY data sets for every km² in Germany (own procedure based on DWD data) and for any location worldwide with [Meteonorm 9](https://www.meteonorm.com/) (data period 2001-2020). In addition, [PVGIS](https://ec.europa.eu/jrc/en/pvgis), [Solcast](https://solcast.com/) and [SolarAnywhere](https://www.solaranywhere.com/) are available as providers. You can use the **interactive map** to conveniently select the climate data. **Own measurement data** can be imported via files in DWD, Meteonorm or WBV format.

The roof areas are covered with the maximum possible number of modules automatically, or manually by tracing the areas to be covered by PV. Thanks to [interfaces to planning tools](https://help.valentin-software.com/pvsol/en/pages/3d-design/interface-to-mounting-system-software/) like [K2 Base (K2 systems)](https://help.valentin-software.com/pvsol/en/pages/3d-design/interface-to-mounting-system-software/) and [PV-Configurator (Renusol)](https://help.valentin-software.com/pvsol/en/pages/3d-design/interface-to-mounting-system-software/), systems no longer have to be planned twice.

##### Polymorphic interconnection in combination with optimizers

Flexibility has been significantly increased when interconnecting the modules that are automatically placed on an object. The new option of polystring interconnection means that completely different strings can be connected in parallel or in series to an MPP tracker. Even different modules in one string, e.g. defective modules that are no longer available, can be replaced with similar ones.

You decide whether you want to connect several module areas to one inverter or choose a separate inverter for each module area, or combine both. The current status of the system check is displayed in the configuration window at all times. Release Notes
Downloads
Learn more
Learn more
The planning tool for PV systems and comprehensive energy systems
Sunny Design 
Discover now 
Design PV systems quickly and conveniently
Sunny Design
With Sunny Design software, you can plan tailor-made PV systems for your customers. It could be a grid-connected PV system with or without a battery-storage system, smart energy management or e-mobility, an off-grid island or hybrid system - Sunny Design takes all technical specifications for the various components into account and provides you with relevant data for a cost-effective assessment of the system. That means that you can match your PV systems to suit the circumstances on-site.
It couldn't be easier. Simply open Sunny Design in your web browser or on your iPad or Android tablet and enter the necessary data in the user-friendly interface. In just a few minutes, Sunny Design will configure the ideal PV system for your customers on your behalf.
You can use Sunny Design free of charge.
Learn more about Sunny Design
Good to know
New
Make your planning even more efficient with our integrated Renusol planning tool
Comprehensive
Plan grid-connected and off-grid PV systems
Receive customized design recommendations
Show potential for optimization
Visual roof planning including shading analysis
Good for customers
All common PV modules available
Incorporate high-resolution meteorological data
Energy-related and financial system assessment
Self-consumption forecast
Flexible
Choice of location worldwide
Import your own meteorological data and load profiles
Access via web browser, iPad or Android tablet
Integrate e-mobility for private homes
Comprehensive energy system planning and simulation
Sunny Design PRO
In addition to the PV system, Sunny Design PRO takes battery-storage systems and thermal components, such as combined heat and power plants and heat pumps, into account in system planning. That means that you can plan and simulate comprehensive sector-linked energy systems. Using customized purchase and feed-in tariffs as well as detailed project and capital costing, you can create reliable efficiency forecasts for the entire system. The extensive project documentation helps with field sales meetings and simplifies subsequent energy system implementation.
It's easy: you can give Sunny Design PRO a try with a month-long free trial. Enter your data to receive a comprehensive and professional visualization of the energy system in no time at all.
You can read more about what Sunny Design PRO has to offer in "Cross-Sector Energy System Planning".
Learn more about Sunny Design PRO
Comprehensive
All sectors in a single application
Simulation of the entire system
Integrated energy management for PV, battery-storage and thermal systems
Planning of electric vehicles and charging stations, including for commercial applications
Impressive
All important energy and efficiency key figures presented
Detailed consumption and load profile analysis
Advanced project documentation
Project templates for commercial energy systems and private homes
Practical
Data export for fast SMA Data Manager commissioning
Flexible management of purchase and feed-in tariffs
Battery-storage system simulation for peak load shaving applications
Overview of Sunny Design functions

Sunny Design PRO

Visual roof planning including shading analysis			
Design of off-grid & PV hybrid systems			
Saving and managing projects

Planning of energy systems with integrated energy			
Import & export of 3D models			
Tariff management

Release Notes Sunny Design 6.10
New features
Further optimization for planning teams in Sunny Design: Teams can now be granted permissions for selected projects instead of the entire project list.
You can set a custom cover page for the project documentation or project exposé in the user settings.
Grouped buildings are displayed as a single object in the roof and string layout.
For CORE2 and STP125, a notification appears when the voltage difference between MPPTs exceeds 80 V.
The algorithm for generating inverter design proposals has been revised.
Sunny Design now uses the language settings from the SMA ID.
Numerous additional improvements and optimizations.
Release Notes Sunny Design 6.00
New features
Teams of multiple system planners can now collaborate in Sunny Design to jointly access and work on projects. This update includes an administration area for creating teams and inviting members, roles and permissions, dedicated team workspaces, and project access management.
One of the project images can now be selected to appear on the cover page of the project documentation. This feature enhances the ability to customize documentation for both customers and the company.
The results now also display the delivered reactive work.
Roof planning
Image overlays in visual roof planning allow you to use your own high-resolution 2D drone images, aerial photographs, or site plans as the basis for planning. Imported images can be freely measured, scaled, and rotated.
Objects such as chimneys, skylights, and more can now be freely rotated on flat roofs.
Sunny Design PRO
Imported 3D models can now be tilted and rotated as needed.
For dynamic rates, time series with 366 days can now be imported.
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.90
New functions
For SMA Chargers PV optimized charging can be simulated. When possible, the electric vehicle is charged exclusively with surplus PV energy. If this is not sufficient, the simulation automatically switches to “Charging with target” to ensure that the vehicle is sufficiently charged.
Import of incomplete consumption profiles is now possible as a 2-column csv file (auto detection). This must contain a date column and a value column.
The price list has been extended for the device types communication products and charging stations.
The Project documentation page has been optimized to ensure a quick and easy access to all downloads.
Visual roof planning
Google Solar API data can now be used in 3D roof planning (Solar potential, Altitude profiles).
Buildings and Objects can be combined and be rotated, shifted etc. as one unit.
Different color schemes can now be selected for strings to improve distinctiveness.
Sunny Design PRO
Time Series for PV production can be uploaded and used for calculation (instead of PV system setup and simulation).
In Energy System projects, a tariff module type “Dynamic tariff (time series)” is available. It enables the import of time series for energy demand prices. These can be used to simulate energy costs.
Imported 3D models may contain objects that are removed before PV installation (as antennas or vents). By selecting the checkbox "Disable collision detection", these can be ignored when assigning modules.
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.80
New functions
Load profiles import from the Sunny Portal powered by ennexOS has been implemented.
In the profitability section individual product information can be set for offers.
The import dialog has been optimized for use with Drag-n-Drop.
In off-grid projects pre-selection of the power grid isn’t required anymore.
New grids for SHP100-JP-21 added.
The yield calculation for STP-60 and STP-70 inverters has been optimized.
The design suggestions have been improved.
Visual roof planning
Buildings and objects may now penetrate eachother, which increases the design possibilities especially for complex buildings.
Roof overhangs can be defined for a more realistic buildings.
PV arrays on facades are now shown in the roof plan.
More realistic light sources are used for the sun position indicator.
Sunny Design PRO
Heat pumps con now be configured for heating and cooling applications (HVAC).
A detailed project exposé to demonstrate the benefits of the system and alternatives can be set up and exported as a Powerpoint document.
The project documentation of energy systems has been extended by an energy balance diagram.
When using the demo version, a watermark is shown in the project documentation of energy system projects.
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.70
New functions
A schematic circuit diagram for the planned PV system can now be downloaded, which includes all essential system components from the PV modules to the grid connection.
Multiple different Sunny Boy Smart Energy hybrid inverters are now available in one design.
Hybrid inverters with batteries, but without PV modules, are now also supported in systems.
There is a new tab "More Project Files" in the output. There, the available documents and files can be conveniently downloaded. Among other things, the device list is now also available there as a CSV file.
In the area of heat pumps, it is now also possible to specify half floors for the building.
In the settings, you can choose between different azimuth definitions.
The link to the Sunny Design product page is now language-dependent.
Improved alert when the session has expired and you are in the roof planning.
A video on the tools for parameterization according to VDE AR-N 4110 has been integrated.
The system validation according to RGIE, Art. 48 (750 V DC) in Belgium has been revised.
Visual roof planning
Calculation of the annual shading of the surfaces and the PV modules can be done manually on the server or, if possible, simultaneously with a new method in the browser (automatic mode). For simple scenes, this is much faster.
Individual modules or module groups can now be rotated in a module field.
Flat roofs can be drawn with any floor plan.
In the case of trailing dormers and trapezoidal dormers, the angle of inclination of the main surface can be changed.
In the case of the building, various roof coverings and wall materials for the facade can now be visualized.
Various objects can now be placed on facades (doors, windows, ventilation grilles and balconies).
When changing modules, the design is retained if the modules have the same width and length.
The map size can be adjusted manually using a slider.
Roof plans can now be saved more easily.
The hiding of shaded PV modules has been improved.
A warning appears when the maximum number of subsystems is exceeded.
The sun position indicator is now enabled by default and can be turned off via the menu at the bottom left.
Sunny Design PRO
The import of 3D models has been improved. The model files can be imported via drag and drop, with up to 10 files per model supported.
In the case of energy system projects, the function "Open overview of electricity purchase costs" is now available on the Results/Profitability page, which can be used to view a detailed analysis of the electricity purchase costs.
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.61
New Functions
On the personal start page, the peak power and a roof planning symbol are displayed for the projects.
It is now possible to choose between a uniform charging tariff for all charging stations or different charging tariffs for each type of charging station.
The simulation of energy system projects with only PV and batteries is now carried out with the same calculation components as for the PV projects and is therefore significantly faster.
Deleting of own locations has been improved.
The project documentation page displays a note about the SMA certification service (for Germany only).
Roof Planning
In roof planning, the scene can be exported as a 3D model (Sunny Design Pro only)
Modules can be placed across two adjacent and equally inclined surfaces.
The string design now has the option to automatically determine the optimal string alignment and starting point.
When roof objects are moved, existing PV modules are automatically removed or added.
If the length of a hipped roof changes, the inclination of the hip roof is maintained. The inclination of the hip can be adjusted by means of an angle input.
Collision detection for large module fields has been optimized.
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.60
New Features (General)
New project type for large-scale systems incl. DC Combiner design
Tools for system parameterization according to VDE AR-N 4110 (Sunny Design Pro)
Alternative map data from Bing
Bifacial gain factor for bifacial PV modules
Warning if the maximum grid connection load is exceeded
Extension of location settings for Australia to overdimensioning of DC inputs (AS/NZS 5033)
Extended database of low-voltage batteries for Sunny Island
Numerous new electric vehicles and manufacturers
Visual roof planning
Support of façade systems
Roof areas with the same orientation and inclination can be grouped
A preferred string length can be set in the string settings
Improved selection of the position of the sun
In step 3, all roof areas can now be deselected
In the event of changes to the building, the PV modules will be retained if possible
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.50
New Features (General)
The Multi-Use operating mode of the STPS X has been integrated.
A device list of the planned SMA system components can now be downloaded.
The optimal row spacing of elevated PV modules can now be calculated.
On saddle, monopitch and hipped roofs, elevated PV modules are now possible.
Dimensions are now displayed on dormers and other objects.
The maximum system voltage of the PV modules is now taken into account per MPP tracker.
Additional hints in roof planning if user inputs cannot be used.
The filters in the "Add communication product" dialog have been optimized.

Sunny Design PRO
Imported 3D models can now also be scaled by measuring.
The display of the category of key figures has been optimized in the user interface as well as in the project documentation.
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.40
New Features (General)
New, improved project documentation
Electromobility also possible in quick planning mode
For charging stations and electric vehicles, differentiation between AC and DC charging
Battery systems now as separate items in the detailed project costs
Subsequent editing of own cost items possible
Management of a price list for battery systems
Roof plan as vector graphic in project documentation
Simplified deletion of load profiles and projects
PV arrays are not deleted when the visual roof plan is removed
Function for optimising PV module design in case of shading
Display of the ground coverage ratio (GCR)
Optimized dialogs for the selection of buildings & objects
Optimization of the naming of inverter inputs
Automatic polystring design for inverter selection
New result value for active power limitation
Start of roof planning in 2D possible
Progress indicator for visual string design
Configurable joint for east-west rack systems
Alignment of objects with dialog
Adjustable visibility and transparency of PV modules

Sunny Design PRO
Import of 3D models
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.30
New Features (General)
The visual roof planning was extended by the electrical design including string planning.
String assembly plans can be created.
Battery systems can now be configured for combined operation of peak load shaving and self-consumption optimization (Multi-Use).
A demand charge can be used in PV projects.
Sunny Design now also supports the energy cost calculation according to the capacity tariff for Belgium.
The energy management design has been optimized for inverters with integrated system manager.
In visual roof planning, the modules with east/west-oriented mounting can no longer be arranged only in pairs, but independently of each other.
Existing buildings can be copied.
Modules and roof objects are preserved when the building height is changed.

## Sunny Design

With Sunny Design software, you can plan tailor-made PV systems for your customers. It could be a grid-connected PV system with or without a battery-storage system, smart energy management or e-mobility, an off-grid island or hybrid system - Sunny Design takes all technical specifications for the various components into account and provides you with relevant data for a cost-effective assessment of the system. That means that you can match your PV systems to suit the circumstances on-site.

It couldn't be easier. Simply open Sunny Design in your web browser or on your iPad or Android tablet and enter the necessary data in the user-friendly interface. In just a few minutes, Sunny Design will configure the ideal PV system for your customers on your behalf.

You can use Sunny Design free of charge.

In addition to the PV system, Sunny Design PRO takes battery-storage systems and thermal components, such as combined heat and power plants and heat pumps, into account in system planning. Our innovative planning tool K2 Base enables fast, safe and accurate planning of PV projects. In just five steps, you can determine the optimal design of your K2 mounting system and the configuration of your PV project. And all of this is free of charge! No wonder K2 Base has become one of the most popular planning tools in the industry.

The optimum K2 mounting system in 5 steps
Google Maps integration and graphic drawing tools facilitate your planning
Automatic determination of wind and snow loads
Intuitive editor for drawing roofs and module arrays
Automatic calculation and depiction of roof fasteners and ballasting
Result report including assembly plan and bill of materials
Data directly transferable into planning tools from SolarEdge, SMA, Fronius, Kostal, GoodWe, PV*SOL premium and archelios™ Pro!
Highlights
Test now 
Plan using our intuitive software
You can use K2 Base via the Web through any PC or Mac without any additional software installation. This way you always have all of your projects in view – clear, in overview form and well structured. Project lists offer you useful filtering options and show you all the important parameters. Satellite images can be used as a basis for planning. Graphical work functions optimally with easy drawing tools.
Innovative planning tool
Creation of multiple roofs and module fields in one project
Working with satellite images and uploaded images (such as drone images, drawings, etc.)
Automatic determination of wind and snow loads
Complete result report: everything documented precisely
Detailed information on verification system utilisation
Automatic calculation and display of roof fastenings and ballasting
Editable bill of materials with module distribution per roof
Share projects with other people – even outside your own organisation
Structural analysis report, assembly plans and ballasting in the form of PDF reports
Send items directly to the shopping carts of your distributor’s webshops
K2 Base has added an interface to the webshop of many PV and electrical wholesalers. This feature simplifies and speeds up the planning and ordering process because K2 Base sends the item list directly to the shopping cart of various webshops.

In just five steps, you can determine the optimal design of your K2 mounting system and the configuration of your PV project. And all of this is free of charge! No wonder K2 Base has become one of the most popular planning tools in the industry.

### Plan using our intuitive software

You can use K2 Base via the Web through any PC or Mac without any additional software installation. This way you always have all of your projects in view – clear, in overview form and well structured. Project lists offer you useful filtering options and show you all the important parameters. Satellite images can be used as a basis for planning. Graphical work functions optimally with easy drawing tools.

![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/K2-Base-info-01.jpg)

### Innovative planning tool

*   Creation of multiple roofs and module fields in one project
*   Working with satellite images and uploaded images (such as drone images, drawings, etc.)
*   Automatic determination of wind and snow loads

![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/K2-Base-info-02.jpg)

### Complete result report: everything documented precisely

*   Detailed information on verification system utilisation
*   Automatic calculation and display of roof fastenings and ballasting
*   Editable bill of materials with module distribution per roof
*   Share projects with other people – even outside your own organisation
*   Structural analysis report, assembly plans and ballasting in the form of PDF reports

![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/K2-Base-info-03.jpg)
